replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: I have a practical but not deep connection with math. I used it in physics and everyday life, like measuring ingredients while baking. My formal education stopped at upper secondary, so I don't have advanced skills, but I appreciate its logic in problem-solving.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, especially when equations get complex. My high neuroticism score means I get stressed with abstract concepts. I try to break problems into smaller steps, but sometimes I panic if I'm stuck for too long.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I tried a math app last year to help with basic algebra. It was useful for quick checks but confusing for advanced topics. I felt frustrated when it didn't explain steps clearly, which made me anxious.

Find the derivative f'(x). Set it equal to zero and solve for x. These x-values are where the slope is zero. Plug them back into f(x) to get the y-coordinates. These points are where the graph has horizontal tangents or peaks/troughs.
replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: PCA reduces data dimensions by finding directions (principal components) that capture most variance.
